title: Accelerated Estimation of the Covariate-Adjusted Lower Makarov Bound
banked_reason: Independent consult confirms terminal below-field outcome: the lone upper-risk target does not substantiate first nontrivial-risk status, strict common-class/common-loss improvement, or matching minimax converse; the same defect persisted after bounded revision.
gap_reasons: This is a lone upper-risk target: it expressly disclaims a strict common-loss improvement over Lee/CAIDE and does not substantiate first nontrivial-risk status or a matching minimax converse, leaving it subfield-tier and below novelty_target=field.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proposed a logarithmically accelerated upper risk bound for the exact covariate-adjusted Makarov endpoint on a continuum tie-inclusive class. A literature repair cleared source positioning issues but did not establish a first risk theorem or strict improvement against a named same-class/common-loss result, and independent consultation found no faithful bounded field-tier repair. No derivation or Lean formalization was completed; the unused positive density lower bound should be removed if re-raised.
tldr: The exact covariate-adjusted lower Makarov endpoint is the infimum compatible fraction with \(Y^1\le Y^0\). Its identification is established. Lee's published conditional-CDF kernel plug-in and Fava's aggregate CAIDE procedure are the principal endpoint comparators. The proposed theorem gives an explicit finite data-only estimator with uniform mean absolute error \(O(u_n)=o(n^{-1/3})\) on the entire fixed scalar-design class, including continuum ties. An empirical fine-path residual preserves the exact supremum; decreasing dyadic noise supports polynomial correction whose approximation and lifted moments are certified together. The candidate advance is a quantitative uniform upper-risk theorem in this benchmark. The source audit does not substantiate a field-wide first-result claim or a strict risk improvement over a published endpoint procedure. The histogram comparison is diagnostic; the intended contribution remains subfield.
gap: Lee \cite{Lee2024ConditionalTreatmentDistributions}, Sections 3.1--3.2 and Theorems 4.1--4.3, is the principal published procedure comparator. Its conditional sharp endpoint is the same object before aggregation, but its asymptotic theory maintains twice differentiable covariate CDFs. The exact integrated endpoint lacks the contracted uniform accelerated absolute-risk theorem in the inspected sources on the full tie-inclusive Lipschitz class.
fill: The empirical continuum residual and a variance-weighted polynomial certificate aim to establish \coreref{thm:uniform-accelerated-upper} for the original exact endpoint. Fava's CAIDE supplies the closest aggregate-endpoint procedure context and robust outer inference on the shared randomized model. The proposed loss guarantee is distinct from coverage and directional limit theory. Its strict rate comparison with the elementary histogram is an internal diagnostic, not evidence of dominance over those procedures.
